_about: Testimonials rendered by can-testimonials.js on the homepage (under the hero), on every v2 offer page (above the checkout) and on every segment page (bottom of the project section). members = Creator quotes from the Kajabi community Wins! channel, the Common Ninja Member Testimonials widget and the Notion 'CAN Testimonials' doc; partners = partner-exec quotes from the Common Ninja partner Testimonials widget. Headshots are rehosted in assets/people/ (Common Ninja CDN, YouTube and Instagram avatars). Set enabled:false to pull a quote without deleting it. Quotes are verbatim except proper-noun spelling fixes (VidCon, Wispr Flow). Order = display order.
